title: Sweet as Honey
old_p1: Heavenly Father held out a scroll to Ezekiel. A scroll is a long paper with writing on it, rolled up like a tube. People wrote on scrolls back then, because there were no books like ours.
This was in a vision, a picture from Heavenly Father. “Eat this scroll,” He said, “then go and speak to my people.”
old_p2: Ezekiel opened his mouth and ate it. It tasted as sweet as honey!

Eating the scroll was a picture lesson. Heavenly Father wanted His words to go all the way inside Ezekiel, so Ezekiel would know them by heart before he taught the people. Heavenly Father’s words are good for us, so they tasted sweet.
When someone reads you the scriptures, those good words go inside you too. Tonight you can rest with sweet words in your heart.
p1: Heavenly Father showed Ezekiel a vision. A hand reached out, holding a long rolled-up paper called a scroll. It was full of writing.
Then He said something surprising: “Eat this scroll. Then go and speak to my people.” His people had stopped listening to Him.
Ezekiel trusted Him. He opened his mouth and ate the scroll. It tasted as sweet as honey!
p2: Why eat a scroll? Heavenly Father wanted His words to go inside Ezekiel. Then Ezekiel would know them by heart when he taught. His words are good, so they tasted sweet.
When someone reads you the scriptures, His words go inside you too. Tonight, ask a grown-up to read you one sweet verse. Keep it in your heart.
